def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split on the full-width/height separator between two equal-sized grids.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row and len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0 and r % 2 == 0 and (h-r-1) == r:
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
            return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(vals)) == 1 and vals[0] != 0 and c % 2 == 0 and (w-c-1) == c:
            return [[2 if grid[r][j] != 0 and grid[r][c+1+j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(c)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('Could not find centered separator')
